taskDescription: Arrange the steps of status epilepticus management in the correct temporal sequence (from first action to last resort).
paragraphs: Stabilise airway, breathing, and circulation; check blood glucose and establish IV access
Administer IV lorazepam (0.1 mg/kg) as first-line benzodiazepine — repeat once after 5 minutes if seizures persist
If seizures persist after two benzodiazepine doses, load IV phenytoin (20 mg/kg at ≤50 mg/min) or fosphenytoin
If seizures continue beyond 30 minutes (refractory SE), initiate general anaesthesia with IV midazolam or propofol infusion in ICU
If SE remains refractory to first-line anaesthetic agents (super-refractory SE), consider thiopental coma or ketamine
